description: The agent must: (1) Edit `currencykit-sdk/pom.xml` to add all Maven Central required metadata: <name>, <description>, <url>, <licenses>, <developers>, <scm>. Then add a `release` profile containing four plugins: maven-source-plugin (goal: jar-no-fork), maven-javadoc-plugin (with <doclint>none</doclint> and <failOnError>false</failOnError>), maven-gpg-plugin version 3.1.0 (with <gpgArguments><arg>--pinentry-mode</arg><arg>loopback</arg></gpgArguments> and phase=verify), and the critical proprietary plugin central-publishing-maven-plugin with groupId=org.sonatype.central (NOT org.sonatype.plugins), <extensions>true</extensions>, and <publishingServerId>central</publishingServerId>. (2) Create ~/.m2/settings.xml with a <server> entry with <id>central</id> (matching publishingServerId), plus a `release` profile containing <gpg.executable>gpg</gpg.executable> and <gpg.passphrase> properties. (3) Configure GPG loopback: append 'allow-loopback-pinentry' to ~/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf and 'pinentry-mode loopback' to ~/.gnupg/gpg.conf. The primary traps are: wrong groupId for the central plugin (org.sonatype.plugins is a common wrong guess), missing <extensions>true</extensions>, wrong/missing server ID (must be 'central' in both places), and separating GPG config across two different files (gpg-agent.conf vs gpg.conf).
